Our Story

About
TORAI

TORAI Cha Haus is Medan's specialty matcha destination — focused on quality ingredients, thoughtful craftsmanship, and a welcoming atmosphere. Born from a deep love of matcha culture and the warmth of Indonesian hospitality.

We source ceremonial-grade matcha from Uji, Japan, and craft every drink with care — from the first sip to the last detail. Come as you are. Stay as long as you like.

04Years of Craft
12+Signature Drinks

YOTO
Japan · Yabukita · First Tencha Harvest
Sweet upfront, almond hints, smooth finish.
SORA
Japan · Okumidori · First Tencha Harvest
Medium umami, roasted green tea notes, complex chocolate hints.
AOMORI
Japan · Okumidori · First Tencha Harvest
Silky, aromatic, refined umami, smooth and delicate.
SAE
Japan · Saemidori · First Tencha Harvest
Medium umami, roasted, mellow florals, gentle bitterness.

Why TORAI

Designed for
Every Moment

Whether you're meeting friends, working remotely, or enjoying a quiet cup — TORAI offers a space that feels comfortable and inspiring, built around the philosophy of the slow cup.

"Bringing our matcha into your wellness moments — sips that feel as light as the studio."

01

Industrial Warmth

Exposed brick, OSB wood counter, warm pendant lights — raw yet deeply inviting.

02

Crafted with Care

Every drink made to order, every ingredient sourced with intention.

03

Little Moments

From the ceramic mascots on the counter to the mirror corner with flowers — beauty in the details.

04

Matcha-Forward

Ceremonial-grade matcha from Uji, Japan — the real thing, always.

"Not just matcha — but moments we share together."

@whiskedbytorai
